phase_prompt.label: Phase 3: Eradicated / The Null Void
phase_prompt.summary: The final deletion. The Sinners are stripped of all assets and cast into the darkness of the system's recycle bin.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A stark, high-contrast shot of the Sinners dissolving into the void. They are reduced to glowing silhouettes and wireframe meshes against a pitch-black background. Particles of data drift away from their forms like smoke. The lighting is minimal, a cold blue rim light that highlights their disintegration. They are alone in the emptiness, separated from the simulation they once ruled. The mood is tragic and final.
